name: 95747 · Roseville, CA
findings: ZIP 95747 (Roseville) has 127 nonprofit organizations. 55 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95747 (Roseville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 95747 (Roseville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 46% of the typical level).
